source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had 4,429 full-time employees, 28% of whom are employed outside of the United States.

payroll.label: The median employee’s total annual compensation in 2025

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The median employee’s total annual compensation in 2025 (as determined using the methodology described below) was $235,115.

notes: Employees: year-end full-time count from the FY2025 10-K (Palantir also uses part-time employees, contractors and third-party personnel, not counted). Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used; the median is identified using base pay, cash incentives and the grant-date value of equity awards made in 2025, and total compensation is calculated as for the named executives.
